title: Template and Config Resolution Provenance
description: Audit of every personal>domain/farm>default resolution during assembly. Non-silent shadowing per spec section 3.7.

resolutions.description: One entry per resolved behavior. Order is assembly sequence.

kind.description: What was resolved. Producers MAY add new kind values; consumers treat unknown kinds as opaque.

resolvedPath.description: The file path that won. Absolute paths are replaced with workspace-relative tokens ($WORKSPACE, $FARMSLOT_HOME) before storage.

tier.description: Which tier the winner came from.

shadows.description: Lower-precedence files that exist but were overridden. Non-empty iff shadowing occurred.
